items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: And then after that I was on a quest. I knew I had to leave Springfield and go to New York. Around that same time was when Clifford Brown and Richie Powell died.

ctx.x: That’s so interesting that you got pulled out of your father’s mode into this thing, and then out of that thing. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

Yeah. No mind of my own. Totally susceptible to really out stuff. But I was. And then after that I was on a quest. I knew I had to leave Springfield and go to New York. Around that same time was when Clifford Brown and Richie Powell died. And I had gotten tickets to go to The Music — well it was in Lenox, Massachusetts — The Music Barn. And they used to have these great festivals. But it was way out in the boondocks, it was like you had to take a bus and all that stuff. Anyhow Max was playing there and then I…
